parameters.name: BindAssets
parameters.description: The IDs of the protected assets to associate, in the format of ["XX1","XX2",...].

parameters.name: BindResourceGroups
parameters.description: The protected object groups to associate, in the format of [**"group1","group2",...**].

parameters.name: BindResources
parameters.description: The protected objects to associate, in the format of [**"XX1","XX2",...**].

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description: The ID of the protection template.

parameters.name: UnbindAssets
parameters.description: The IDs of the protected assets to disassociate, in the format of ["XX1","XX2",...].

parameters.name: UnbindResourceGroups
parameters.description: The protected object groups to disassociate, in the format of [**"group1","group2",...**].

parameters.name: UnbindResources
parameters.description: The protected objects to disassociate, in the format of [**"XX1","XX2",...**].
